statistical_unit_across_runs: Each seed is an independent pretrained Basin2Vec checkpoint and uses the same numeric seed for downstream LSTM initialization.
temporal_primary: Median NSE/KGE across temporal evaluation basins for each seed; then mean ± sample standard deviation across seeds.
spatial_foldmean: Matches the supplied spatial evaluator's KFOLD_AGGREGATED output: mean of the six outer-fold median basin metrics within each seed; then mean ± sample standard deviation across seeds.
spatial_pooled: Additional audit statistic: pool each basin's outer-fold test metric exactly once and take the median across all held-out basins.
